0022600031.text: The Timberwolves (5-3, on a one-game win streak and 3rd in the Northwest, 1 game back) visit the Pelicans (3-4, winners of three straight and 5th in the Southwest, 3.5 games back) in an Emirates NBA Cup West Group B regular-season game. Minnesota will be without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), and Terrence Shannon Jr. (hip bruise), while New Orleans will be without Trey Murphy III (knee) and Yves Missi (knee bruise). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Minnesota won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 132-126 win in Minneapolis on April 12, 2026.
